Description: {{TAG|VDW_SR8}} sets the radii scaling <math>s_{r,8}</math> in the dipole-quadrupole zero-damping function of the DFT-D3 method.
{{Available|6.6.0}}
----
{{TAG|VDW_SR8}} allows to set the radii scaling <math>s_{r,8}</math> in the dipole-quadrupole zero-damping function of the DFT-D3 method. {{TAG|VDW_SR8}} can be used for both implementations of DFT-D3: [[DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=11) and [[simple-DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15 with {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}}=zero or mzero).
